english_outline.section1: Tesla Q3 2026 revenue beat estimates; automotive gross margin ex credits 18.1% above Visible Alpha estimate 16.7%; deliveries 486,532 beat ~461,100 but down 2% y/y; energy storage growth; capex $4.7B below LSEG estimate $7.5B.
english_outline.section2: Deliveries outpaced production by >22,000 for second straight quarter, drawing down inventory; Model 3/Y dominate, other models 8,295 down from 12,364 in Q2; Model S/X production ended, replaced by Optimus line; energy storage grows on grid-scale battery demand; capex cut before potential SpaceX deal.
english_outline.section3: Higher margin and inventory drawdown improve near-term cash flow; but lower capex raises questions about funding AI/robotaxi ambitions; energy storage provides counterweight; profit weighed by AI and robotaxi spending.
english_outline.section4: Shares fell ~14% year-to-date; market values Tesla at ~$1.4T on future self-driving/robotics expectations; Goldman Sachs reiterates Neutral on mixed Q3; robotaxi rollout lagging Musk promises.
english_outline.section5: Next quarter: evidence of commercial robotaxi progress (Cybercab fleet expansion, Dallas launch); energy storage growth sustainability; capex trajectory for AI/robotics; Europe FSD approval vote.

checks.question: 高盛重申特斯拉“中性”评级这一说法，在所提供的来源中是否有可核实的依据？
checks.result: 不成立。所附高盛相关来源仅有标题，无正文或摘要，无法核实其评级内容；官方来源与路透报道均未提及高盛评级。修订稿删除该机构观点。

checks.question: 特斯拉第三季度资本支出47亿美元、低于分析师预期75亿美元，这一对比是否来自可靠来源？
checks.result: 成立。路透报道明确称特斯拉当季资本支出47亿美元，为上年同期两倍，但低于LSEG统计的分析师平均预期75亿美元。修订稿保留该对比。

checks.result: 成立。路透报道明确称公司股价今年迄今下跌约14%，市值约1.4万亿美元，仍是全球市值最高的汽车制造商。修订稿保留。
